City Council Meeting
AGENDA FOR LA MIRADA City Council Meeting
November 14, 2017 –
6:30
p.m.
COUNCIL CHAMBERS, CITY HALL, 13700 LA MIRADA BOULEVARD,
LA MIRADA, CALIFORNIA 90638
In-Person Public Participation Information
To address the City Council on an Agenda item other than a Public Hearing or during Public
Comments, please fill out a "Request to Address Council" card located in the back of the Council
Chambers near the agendas and submit to the City Clerk prior to the meeting or as soon as
possible. There is a five minute maximum time limit when addressing the City Council. The amount
of time for public comment may be reduced by the Mayor or by action of the City Council
Electronic Public Participation
To submit your Public Comments electronically in advance, please email your written comments to
cityclerk@lamirada.gov. The deadline to submit your Public Comment electronically is on the day
of a regular City Council meeting before 3 p.m. For special meetings, comments must be received
at least three hours prior to the meeting.
Members of the public may participate in this meeting via remote attendance by using the Zoom
Webinar information.
Zoom Meeting Details: www.zoom.us/join
Meeting ID: 897 8121 0338 Telephone Option: 1-669-444-9171
(*6 to unmute; *9 to raise hand)
Public Comment will begin with speakers attending in-person first followed by those attending via
Zoom Webinar.
Reasonable Accommodations
In compliance with the Americans with Disabilities Act, if you need special assistance to participate
in a City Council meeting or other service offered by the City, contact the City Clerk's Office at
(562) 943-0131. Notification at least 48 hours prior to the meeting or time when services are
needed will assist City staff in assuring that reasonable arrangements can be made to provide
accessibility to the meeting or service.
Agenda Materials
Copies of staff reports and supporting documentation pertaining to agenda items are available for
public viewing and inspection at City Hall during regular business hours and on the City's website
http://www.lamirada.gov. For further information regarding agenda items, please contact the
City Clerk's office at (562) 943-0131.
1.
CALL TO ORDER
2.
INVOCATION: Councilmember Lewis

5.
PUBLIC COMMENTS
6.
APPEARANCES, PRESENTATIONS, AND PROCLAMATIONS
6.1
RECOGNITION OF FORMER COMMISSIONER AND MEMBER OF THE LA MIRADA COMMUNITY FOUNDATION - It is recommended the City Council present an appreciation plaque and tickets to the La Mirada Theatre for the Performing Arts to Jim Reich and Dr. Rick Bee for their years of dedicated service to the community.
6.1 Recognition of Former Commissioner and Member of the Foundation
6.2
RECOGNITION OF UNSYNCABLES OF LA MIRADA - It is recommended the City Council recognize the Unsyncables of La Mirada and present the team with a recognition plaque.
6.2 Recognition of Unsyncables of La Mirada
7.
CONSENT CALENDAR
7.1
APPROVAL OF MEETING MINUTES - It is recommended the City Council approve the minutes of the regular meeting of October 24, 2017.
7.1 Meeting Minutes of October 24, 2017
7.2
APPROVAL OF WARRANT REGISTER - It is recommended the City Council approve the warrant register dated November 14, 2017 in the total amount of $2,107,949.90.
7.2 Warrant Register
7.3
CAPITAL IMPROVEMENT PROJECT NO. 2014-18, STPL-5364(009), TRAFFIC SIGNAL INSTALLATION, ARTESIA BOULEVARD AT EAST INDUSTRY CIRCLE - ACCEPTANCE OF WORK - It is recommended the City Council accept the improvements constructed by Elecnor Belco Electric, Inc.; authorize the City Clerk to file a Notice of Completion with the County Recorder; and authorize the payment of retention monies pursuant to the contract.
7.3 CIP No. 2014-18
7.4
CAPITAL IMPROVEMENT PROJECT NO. 2016-12, TRAFFIC SIGNAL INSTALLATION AT ALONDRA BOULEVARD AND PHOEBE AVENUE â€“ APPROVAL OF A CHANGE ORDER TO AMENDMENT FOR THE ON-CALL PROFESSIONAL/TECHNICAL SERVICES AGREEMENT WITH CNC ENGINEERING - It is recommended the City Council approve and authorize the City Manager to execute Contract Change Order No. 1 to Amendment No. 11, Professional Services Agreement between the City of La Mirada and CNC Engineering for Capital Improvement Project No. 2016-12, Traffic Signal Installation at Alondra Boulevard and Phoebe Avenue in the amount of $12,455.
7.4 CIP No. 2016-12
8.
ORDINANCES AND RESOLUTIONS
8.1
SECOND READING AND ADOPTION OF ORDINANCE NO. 701 MOVING CITY COUNCIL ELECTIONS TO A STATEWIDE ELECTION DATE AS REQUIRED BY LAW - It is recommended the City Council accept for second reading and adopt Ordinance No. 701 moving City Council elections to a statewide election date as required by state law, by title only, and waive further reading.
8.1 Ordinance No. 701
8.2
FIRST READING OF ORDINANCE NO. 703 REPEALING REGULATIONS APPLICABLE TO GARAGE SALE DEPOSITS, AND AMENDING TITLE 9 OF THE LA MIRADA MUNICIPAL CODE - It is recommended the City Council introduce for first reading Ordinance No. 703 repealing regulations applicable to garage sale deposits, and amending Title 9 of the La Mirada Municipal Code, by title only, and waive further reading.
8.2 Ordinance No. 703
8.3
FIRST READING OF ORDINANCE NO. 704 REAUTHORIZING AND READOPTING THE CITY'S PUBLIC, EDUCATIONAL, AND GOVERNMENTAL ACCESS SUPPORT FEE - It is recommended the City Council introduce for first reading Ordinance No. 704 reauthorizing and readopting the City's public, educational, and governmental access support fee, by title only, and waive further reading.
8.3 Ordinance No. 704
8.4
RESOLUTION NO. 17-33 APPROVING AN APPLICATION FOR TRANSIT AND TRANSPORTATION FUNDS – It is recommended the City Council adopt Resolution No. 17-33 approving an application for transit funds from PTMISEA and authorize the City Manager to execute an application for funds from PTMISEA for the purchase of transit vehicles, passenger fare boxes and related equipment.
8.4 Resolution No. 17-33
